scope: Three generated internal slide actions were tested in PowerPoint slide show using Tab to focus and Return to activate: shape 1→3, text run 3→1 and table-cell run 3→2. After selecting the slide-2 title, pressing Right, saving and reopening once, all three keyboard activations reached the same pages again; no repair prompt was observed. On that reopened file, clicking each link object exposed by the accessibility tree also reached its expected page (text 3→1, shape 1→3, table 3→2). UI provenance is observational and not authenticated.
limitations: One three-slide sample and one native save/reopen. Earlier coordinate clicks advanced normally rather than reaching their intended target; their coordinate mapping or hotspot behavior was not resolved. Accessibility-object clicks establish only those selected points, not the full clickable area. External URLs, native editing of links, other consumers and source-preserving edits were not tested.
